effective_compiler_scope: Actual 203 Rust invocation argv per source and semantically reviewed GNU/Linux PHREEQC compiler/configured flags plus pinned target-option logic. Full native per-translation-unit argv coverage is not claimed.
limitations: Offline captured API/job/run/artifact verification; no new network fetch.
Source HEAD/tree/clean guards and initialized recursive module identities are recorded evidence; whole hosted source/module bytes not independently reread.
Bounded parent build files and pinned IPhreeqc CMakeLists independently checked; all parent Git changes confined to CLI source and locale fixture.
Native compiler flags accepted from actual configure command, caches and pinned option logic; no exhaustive native translation-unit argv or object bytes audit.

Ninja generator and gcc ar/ranlib are observed through caches but their executable versions/hashes were not captured separately; same hosted build/toolchain and source/config binding is scoped environment proof.
Captured tool hashes not independently recomputed on absent hosted tool binaries.
Actual-target directory placement and later runtime clocks/output equality require separate execution evidence.
New paired protocol must bind rebuilt baseline/candidate bytes and own controls before execution.
